_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Space Station 14 egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Space Station 14
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Space Station 14, the multiplayer space station roleplay game. Installs the official server build, or a fork's from its build manifest.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Space Station 14: downloads a server build from the build manifest (Space
# Wizards' by default, or a fork's) and checks it against the manifest's
# SHA-256. The database, config and logs are never touched; the server's
# files are replaced only once the new build is downloaded and unpacked.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

manifest_url="${BUILD_MANIFEST:-https://wizards.cdn.spacestation14.com/fork/wizards/manifest}"
manifest=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$manifest_url") || fail "The build manifest at $manifest_url can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
jq -e '.builds | type == "object"' <<<"$manifest" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "$manifest_url isn't a Space Station 14 build manifest."

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) platform=linux-x64 ;;
    aarch64) platform=linux-arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Space Station 14 has no server for this CPU." ;;
esac

want="${SS14_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    version=$(jq -r --arg p "$platform" '[.builds | to_entries[] | select(.value.server[$p])] | sort_by(.value.time) | last | .key // empty' <<<"$manifest")
    [ -n "$version" ] || fail "The manifest has no server build for $platform."
else
    version=$(jq -r --arg v "$want" '[.builds | keys[] | select(startswith($v))] | if length == 1 then .[0] else empty end' <<<"$manifest")
    [ -n "$version" ] || fail "The manifest has no build $want (or more than one starts with it). Set Version to latest, or to a build's full commit hash."
fi
url=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" --arg p "$platform" '.builds[$v].server[$p].url // empty' <<<"$manifest")
sum=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" --arg p "$platform" '.builds[$v].server[$p].sha256 // empty | ascii_downcase' <<<"$manifest")
[ -n "$url" ] || fail "Build $version has no server for $platform."

if [ -f Robust.Server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $platform" ]; then
    echo "Space Station 14 build ${version:0:12} is already installed."
else
    mkdir -p "$build/x"
    echo "Downloading Space Station 14 build ${version:0:12} ($platform)"
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$build/server.zip" "$url" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    if [ -n "$sum" ]; then
        [ "$(sha256sum "$build/server.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "The download didn't match the manifest's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    unzip -q "$build/server.zip" -d "$build/x"
    # The server's settings are its own after the first install.
    if [ -f server_config.toml ]; then rm -f "$build/x/server_config.toml"; fi
    # Files the last build had and this one doesn't are removed; nothing else.
    (cd "$build/x" && find . -type f | sort) > "$build/files"
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        comm -23 <(sort .raptor-files) "$build/files" | while read -r f; do rm -f -- "$f"; rmdir -p --ignore-fail-on-non-empty "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null || true; done
    fi
    cp -a "$build/x/." .
    mv -f "$build/files" .raptor-files
    chmod +x Robust.Server
    echo "$version $platform" > .raptor-version
fi
echo "Installed Space Station 14 build ${version:0:12}."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The build's commit hash from the manifest, or latest for the newest build. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Build manifest
variables.description: The build manifest to install from. Change it to run a fork's builds.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Max connections
variables.description: The most players that can be connected at once.
